item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-5ef7d15cccab0629","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"China’s revised Women’s Rights and Interests Protection Law took effect on 1 January 2023. It defines gender equality as a basic national policy, assigns governments implementation and budget responsibilities, and requires gender-equality assessment and statistical monitoring.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.3","6B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Implemented during 2023; the law was revised in 2022 and effective from 1 January 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The law operates under Communist Party leadership and the state institutions led by Xi Jinping; the source does not establish Xi’s personal role in individual provisions.","limitations":["The text establishes legal duties but does not demonstrate nationwide implementation outcomes or equal enforcement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ef7d15cccab0629","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The law prohibits unlawful detention, trafficking, sexual harassment, and sexual assault; requires schools and employers to establish prevention, complaint, investigation, privacy, and protective procedures; and provides routes to public-security organs, courts, and civil remedies.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.7","3B.9","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Statutory safeguards were in force during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"A national law enacted by China’s central legislative institutions during Xi’s tenure; personal direction by Xi is not shown.","limitations":["The source does not show complaint volumes, enforcement rates, or remedies delivered in 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ef7d15cccab0629","start_unit":6,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"The law requires equal access for women to education, employment, social security, equal pay, promotion, maternity protection, and protection from gender discrimination; labor-security departments must supervise discrimination in recruitment, employment, promotion, training, and dismissal.","question_ids":["3B.7","5B.8","6B.2","6B.3","6B.8","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Statutory provisions applied during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"National policy and administrative responsibilities under the central state during Xi’s tenure; no personal Xi act is specified.","limitations":["Legal commitments do not establish actual incidence, compliance, or equal access across regions and sectors."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5ef7d15cccab0629","start_unit":8,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"The law creates complaint, legal-aid, mediation, arbitration, litigation, supervisory, hotline, and public-interest litigation mechanisms, and authorizes sanctions for authorities or employers that suppress complaints, fail to investigate, or violate women’s rights.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.7","3B.8","6B.5","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Remedial mechanisms were legally available during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"National legislation and enforcement architecture during Xi’s tenure; the source does not demonstrate Xi’s personal intervention.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether these remedies were independent, accessible, or effective in practice."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5b329405daed1075","start_unit":3,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Freedom House describes China as operating a global transnational-repression campaign targeting ethnic and religious minorities, dissidents, activists, journalists, and former officials through renditions, detention, mobility controls, digital threats, spyware, family intimidation, diplomatic pressure, and proxy entities. It attributes the campaign’s expansion to power concentration under Xi Jinping and his assertive foreign policy.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.3","3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9","7B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report is from 2021 and describes a campaign escalating since 2014; it is relevant as institutional context but does not provide a 2023-specific incident.","ruler_attribution":"Freedom House explicitly links the campaign’s escalation to Xi’s concentration of power and foreign-policy emphasis.","limitations":["The source is an external analytical report and much of its incident evidence predates 2023.","It describes party-state and proxy conduct without proving Xi personally ordered each incident."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5b329405daed1075","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The report states that China’s extraterritorial control was codified through laws including the National Intelligence Law and Hong Kong National Security Law, while Uyghurs and Tibetans abroad faced coerced returns, intimidation, family threats, spyware, and surveillance.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.3","3B.5","4B.3","4B.9","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The cited laws and patterns largely predate 2023 but remained relevant to the 2023 institutional posture.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the broader extraterritorial strategy to the CCP under Xi’s leadership.","limitations":["The supplied units do not establish 2023 enforcement figures or a specific 2023 decision."]},{"source_id":"SRC-5b329405daed1075","start_unit":9,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"China’s global anticorruption campaigns Fox Hunt and Skynet pursued alleged fugitives abroad; Chinese state media claimed 3,000 people had returned or been repatriated from 90 countries by 2018, while external investigations described surveillance, threats, stalking, and family intimidation used to induce returns.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.5","4B.9","7B.7","7B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The campaign predates 2023; the source provides institutional background rather than a 2023 outcome.","ruler_attribution":"The report links the campaign to Xi’s anticorruption drive and the CCP’s party-state apparatus.","limitations":["The government presents the campaign as lawful anticorruption cooperation, while the report documents allegations of coercive methods; the supplied text does not resolve every case."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cfe3ab97a1e08cb8","start_unit":2,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"China’s 2023 statistical communiqué reported GDP growth of 5.2%, per-capita GDP growth of 5.4%, urban surveyed unemployment averaging 5.2%, and 12.44 million new urban jobs; it also reported population decline of 2.08 million and a natural growth rate of -1.48 per thousand.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Direct 2023 national outcome data.","ruler_attribution":"The communiqué explicitly attributes the policy direction and results to the CPC Central Committee with Xi Jinping at its core.","limitations":["The communiqué is an official source and reports preliminary statistics; it does not establish causal attribution or independent verification.","Population decline and labor-market figures qualify the favorable growth results."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cfe3ab97a1e08cb8","start_unit":12,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"In 2023, equipment manufacturing value added grew 6.8%, high-tech manufacturing 2.7%, new-energy-vehicle output 30.3%, solar-cell output 54.0%, high-tech investment 10.3%, and newly established business entities reached 32.73 million; clean-energy generation grew 7.8%, while carbon intensity was unchanged and only 59.9% of monitored cities met air-quality standards.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.10","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Direct 2023 results.","ruler_attribution":"The communiqué presents these results as implementation of the central leadership’s development strategy under Xi.","limitations":["Official aggregate indicators do not show distribution, environmental causality, or whether all outcomes resulted from Xi-directed policy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cfe3ab97a1e08cb8","start_unit":32,"end_unit":34,"fact_summary":"Industrial enterprise profits fell 2.3% in 2023, the profit margin fell 0.20 percentage points to 5.76%, and capacity utilization was 75.1%, although asset-liability ratios declined slightly.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.4","5B.9","5B.10","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Direct 2023 results.","ruler_attribution":"The figures concern the national economy governed under Xi’s central leadership; they do not identify a personal Xi decision.","limitations":["The source does not identify causes or distinguish central policy effects from external conditions."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cfe3ab97a1e08cb8","start_unit":54,"end_unit":63,"fact_summary":"Fixed-asset investment grew 2.8% in 2023, but private investment fell 0.4%; real-estate development investment fell 9.6%, new housing sales area fell 8.5%, and developer funds fell 13.6%. At the same time, 1.59 million rundown-area housing units were started for rebuilding, 2.13 million subsidized rental units were started or supplied, and 5.37万 old urban communities began renovation.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.6","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Direct 2023 results.","ruler_attribution":"National fiscal, housing, and investment policy operated under Xi’s central leadership; personal authorship is not shown.","limitations":["The data combine adverse market results with government programs and do not establish program quality, completion, or distribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cfe3ab97a1e08cb8","start_unit":97,"end_unit":103,"fact_summary":"In 2023, real per-capita disposable income grew 6.1% nationally, 4.8% for urban residents, and 7.6% for rural residents; the urban-rural income ratio narrowed to 2.39. Basic medical insurance covered 1.33387 billion people, while 33.99 million rural residents received minimum living allowances and 7.42 million person-times of temporary assistance were provided.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct 2023 results.","ruler_attribution":"Official data describe programs administered under the central leadership led by Xi.","limitations":["National averages and administrative coverage figures do not establish adequacy, uptake, exclusion, or regional equality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cfe3ab97a1e08cb8","start_unit":103,"end_unit":110,"fact_summary":"China reported 2023 R&D expenditure of 3.3278 trillion yuan, 2.64% of GDP, 921,000 invention patents granted, 66 successful space launches, and a 95.7% compulsory-education completion rate.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.10","6B.2","6B.9","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Direct 2023 results.","ruler_attribution":"The communiqué frames these outcomes as implementation of national development priorities under Xi’s leadership.","limitations":["The official report does not establish research independence, educational quality, or causal contribution by Xi personally."]},{"source_id":"SRC-cfe3ab97a1e08cb8","start_unit":117,"end_unit":124,"fact_summary":"In 2023, water consumption per unit of GDP fell 6.4% and energy intensity fell 0.5%; clean energy accounted for 26.4% of energy consumption. However, PM2.5 concentration rose 3.4%, coal consumption rose 5.6%, and coal remained 55.3% of total energy consumption.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.9","5B.10","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Direct 2023 results.","ruler_attribution":"National environmental and energy policy operated under Xi’s central leadership.","limitations":["The source reports preliminary official statistics and does not establish independent environmental validation or policy causality."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c4f3d695fa7d2630","start_unit":3,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"A CECC analysis reported that China’s disability assistance system depends on disability certification: official estimates identified 85 million persons with disabilities, but only 37.8 million were registered as of 2021, leaving more than 44% potentially outside assistance eligibility. The analysis also reported persistent poverty and corruption or dereliction undermining assistance.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.8","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The evidence is mainly 2021-2022 and provides structural context for 2023, not a 2023 measurement.","ruler_attribution":"The analysis concerns PRC government programs; it does not establish Xi’s personal decision in disability registration policy.","limitations":["The 85 million estimate and registration gap are not 2023 figures.","The claim that unregistered persons lack assistance is presented as a likely implication, not a complete enumeration."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c4f3d695fa7d2630","start_unit":6,"end_unit":9,"fact_summary":"The disability assistance system included dibao, two disability allowances, tekun support, employment services, and tax incentives, but benefit levels varied locally and were often low; a 2023 review reported monthly two-allowance amounts ranging from 75 to 188 yuan for indigent subsidies and 75 to 252 yuan for nursing subsidies in 11 provincial jurisdictions. Research found limited income and quality-of-life improvement from employment services, especially for people with psychiatric or multiple disabilities.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.4","6B.5","6B.8","6B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Includes a 2023 benefit-level datapoint; broader effectiveness evidence is from earlier studies.","ruler_attribution":"Programs were established and administered by PRC central and local authorities during Xi’s tenure; personal direction is not demonstrated.","limitations":["Benefit amounts are from selected jurisdictions and cannot be generalized nationally.","The research identifies associations and implementation limitations rather than a complete causal evaluation of 2023 policy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c4f3d695fa7d2630","start_unit":9,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"The China Disabled Persons’ Federation is government-controlled and serves as a conduit for party directives; civil-society organizations face registration, fundraising, national-security, and Party-branch restrictions. The analysis reports that disability advocates were detained or organizations shut down, while some local offices contracted nonprofits for service delivery.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9","6B.4","6B.5","6B.9","7B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Institutional conditions documented through 2023, with examples from earlier years.","ruler_attribution":"The analysis describes party-state governance under Xi’s leadership but does not attribute each restriction to Xi personally.","limitations":["The source combines legal rules, organizational structure, and selected cases from different years.","It does not quantify 2023 contracting or detention outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-c4f3d695fa7d2630","start_unit":11,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"A 2021 study found rural hukou was associated with a 13-40% increase in unmet healthcare needs among persons with disabilities, who were over 79% rural residents. In April 2023, a court sentenced the husband in the Feng County chained-woman case to nine years and five traffickers to 8-13 years, after public criticism and reported earlier official failures to protect the victim.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.2","6B.3","6B.8","6B.10","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The healthcare study is pre-2023; the court event occurred in April 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The court action is an institutional act under the PRC state; no personal Xi involvement is shown.","limitations":["The case demonstrates a remedy after severe harm but does not establish systemic prevention or nationwide enforcement.","The study’s healthcare estimate predates the target period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2c81c67e7544c374","start_unit":13,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"A peer-reviewed study found that China’s long-term-care-insurance pilots, launched from 2012 onward and expanded to 49 cities by 2020, reduced multidimensional poverty and future poverty vulnerability among middle-aged and older adults. By 2020, 108.353 million people participated and 835,000 received benefits.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.9","6B.10","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The study was published in 2023 but evaluates 2011-2018 survey data and policy expansion through 2020; it is relevant background for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The study identifies central-government guidelines and pilot expansion, but does not attribute the observed effects personally to Xi.","limitations":["The evidence does not measure outcomes specifically during 2023.","The authors note that treatment effects include possible spillovers and that direct service receipt was not observed."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2c81c67e7544c374","start_unit":65,"end_unit":82,"fact_summary":"Using individual and year fixed effects, difference-in-differences, matching, and clustered errors, the study estimated that LTCI reduced multidimensional poverty by 21.53% after implementation; coverage reduced income poverty by 27.7% and health poverty by 12.2% in matched samples, while some material-wellbeing, social-participation, and psychological-wellbeing effects were not statistically significant.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Peer-reviewed evidence published in 2023 using pre-2023 panel data.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern government LTCI pilots, not a personal Xi decision.","limitations":["The authors caution that pilot selection was nonrandom, individual receipt was unobserved, and effects include direct and spillover effects.","Not all welfare dimensions improved significantly."]},{"source_id":"SRC-2c81c67e7544c374","start_unit":87,"end_unit":99,"fact_summary":"The study found larger LTCI effects for people with greater care needs and higher multidimensional poverty, but also found that institutional-care-only pilots increased social-participation poverty. The authors concluded that fiscal subsidies, coverage of moderate and severe disability, and higher reimbursement were associated with stronger effects, while rural care resources remained undersupplied.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.5","6B.8","6B.10","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Peer-reviewed evidence published in 2023 using policy and survey data before 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern state-designed pilot programs; Xi’s personal role is not established.","limitations":["The study cannot separately estimate effects by service type for individual beneficiaries and notes data and selection limitations."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-9fcc1abc6c20b9e4","SRC-8568f76739920c35","SRC-d77cfca4c508e5e2","SRC-64b0c5aa8417b2a1","SRC-57415e80575b96c8"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents are metadata pages, 2025 material, pre-2023 reports, or outside-period treaty observations; they were not treated as direct 2023 evidence.","No score was assigned.","The supplied corpus contains no direct evidence on Xi Jinping’s personal assets, conflicts of interest, appointments, nuclear command decisions, conventional war authorization, or 2023 truthfulness beyond institutional and official-source attribution."]}
